title: Pointwise Characterization of Computation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $T$ be a binary decision tree with available coordinates $A$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\alpha$. The tree computes $f$ if and only if, for every input $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, its evaluation at $x$ equals $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$T$ is a binary decision tree with available coordinates $A$
replaced:
